sources.title: Managing Forms in Collect — ODK Docs
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation retrieved 2026-10-10; the page states finalized/sent editing was added with Collect v2025.2.0 and Central v2025.1.4.
sources.locator: Finalizing drafts and Ready to send, page lines 144–168; opt-in finalized/sent edits and ordering, lines 181–198.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official documentation and read the device states, offline-send condition, and version-gated client-edit section.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Offline or auto-send-disabled finalized forms are on the device Ready to send list and not editable there by default. `client_editable=true` is opt-in; edits use the original form version, are tracked in Central, and manual queued edits must be sent in order.
sources.applicability: Supports a local Android queue and configured correction path; does not establish that coordinators can see device-local pending or receipt-unknown events before sync.

sources.title: Metadata Scheme — ODK Docs / OpenRosa
sources.version_or_commit: Living OpenRosa/XForms metadata documentation retrieved 2026-10-10; no product build pinned.
sources.locator: Form identity and version, lines 147–176; completed-form `instanceID`, `timeStart`, `timeEnd`, and `deprecatedID`, lines 177–206.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary metadata reference and inspected the form/submission identity and timestamp definitions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Form identity/version are XForm metadata; `instanceID` is required and must be universally unique for a submission. `timeStart`/`timeEnd` are client timestamps. `deprecatedID` may identify a revision; server handling controls consolidation.
sources.applicability: Supports the proposed identity model and clock-uncertainty distinction, but does not certify phone clock accuracy or a chosen correction display policy.

sources.title: Managing Forms in Central — ODK Docs
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation retrieved 2026-10-10; form lifecycle behavior is not tied to a deployed Central build.
sources.locator: Form drafting and access, lines 121–127 and following access section; updating forms and removed-field export behavior, lines 221–232.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official Central form-management page and read draft/publish, form access, version-update, and removed-field export conditions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A new form version may be published; old submissions persist. Removed fields are omitted from exports by default, with a prior-version-fields export option. Form access must be set for the relevant App Users.
sources.applicability: Supports the version/export warning and access tradeoff. Actual volunteer access, old downloaded forms, and a deployment are not tested.

sources.title: Managing Submissions in Central — ODK Docs
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation retrieved 2026-10-10; the page does not pin a Central build for these UI behaviors.
sources.locator: CSV ZIP `files/` folders keyed by submission instance ID, page line 234; activity feed and edit-version behavior, lines 311–317; web-form offline limitation, lines 319–325.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official submission-management page and directly inspected attachment export, edit activity/version, and offline web-form passages.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: ZIP export places attachments in `files/` subfolders named by submission `instanceId`; edits create a new submission version and review state Edited. ODK Web Forms still require internet to submit; Enketo can queue in offline-capable mode while its conditions hold.
sources.applicability: Supports export and correction qualifications, not an end-to-end export check or a coordinator-visible mobile queue.

sources.title: Submission Management — ODK Docs
sources.version_or_commit: Current living Central REST API documentation retrieved 2026-10-10; `deviceId` and version fields have documented historical version notes.
sources.locator: Submission/form version identity, lines 119–123; `createdAt` server receipt semantics, lines 192–195; REST XML create, attachment follow-up, and duplicate-ID 409, lines 264–270; CSV export endpoints, lines 1009–1119.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official API reference and inspected identity, server receipt, create/attachment, duplicate response, and export sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: An existing `instanceId` in the REST-create endpoint returns 409. That endpoint takes XML; attachments are added through later endpoints. `createdAt` is the server-received time. The cited docs establish CSV export, not a native CSV-to-submission import.
sources.applicability: Supports reconciliation and server-receipt recommendations; 409 alone does not show a coordinator the device queue or prove the legacy CSV route.

sources.title: Prevent editing of submissions that failed to send — ODK Collect issue #4589
sources.version_or_commit: Historical issue opened 2021-06-02 and closed through PR #4655.
sources.locator: Issue report, lines 129–164; maintainer explanation of lost POST result/limbo, lines 302–306.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the public issue and read the original failure report and maintainer discussion.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The reported case is server acceptance with no response reaching the client, followed by editing a failed local record and resubmitting different XML under the same ID.
sources.applicability: A bounded historic reconnect case only; not evidence of a current defect, exactly-once behavior, or arbitrary duplicate resolution.

sources.applicability: Confirms a narrow historical code fix and regression witness, not general exactly-once delivery.

sources.title: Submit survey results — ArcGIS Survey123 documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living Survey123 documentation retrieved 2026-10-10; app build not pinned.
sources.locator: Offline Save in Outbox/send after reconnection, lines 20–33.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official field-app documentation and read the offline Outbox and post-submit edit conditions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: With no internet, a completed response can be saved in Outbox; unsent surveys can be sent after reconnecting. Post-submit editing depends on configuration.
sources.applicability: Confirms an Android offline candidate and device-local queue; does not prove coordinator-visible pending-state behavior.

sources.title: Publish a survey — ArcGIS Survey123 documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation retrieved 2026-10-10; no app/server build pinned.
sources.locator: Publish sync option and Enterprise web-map caveat, lines 55–70; Sent-folder edit default and Inbox/Sent stale-data warning, lines 83–94.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official publishing page and checked sync defaults, Enterprise conditions, sent-edit default, and Inbox/Sent interaction.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Feature-layer sync is off by default and is required for offline map areas configured for a web map. Editing sent surveys is off by default; enabling both Sent and Inbox can leave another device's update undownloaded.
sources.applicability: Supports the conditional deployment/correction tradeoff; exact charity layer and permissions are unknown.

sources.title: Edit existing survey data — ArcGIS Survey123 documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation retrieved 2026-10-10; global-ID editing behavior starts at Survey123 3.9; Enterprise attachment limitation is version-qualified on the page.
sources.locator: Individual-response edit privileges and attachment edits, lines 34–63; nested-repeat and older Enterprise attachment limitations, lines 91–96.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official correction page and read authorization, attachment editing, and limitations.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Individual response edits need submitter/viewer and add/update privileges; attachments may be changed in that path. Nested-repeat surveys are unsupported; Enterprise surveys before 10.8.1 with attachment questions are unsupported for the described edit path.
sources.applicability: Supports a configured correction candidate, not immutable append-only history or the charity's owner-selected view policy.

sources.title: View your results — ArcGIS Survey123 documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation retrieved 2026-10-10; no app/server build pinned.
sources.locator: Data/attachments and download formats, lines 47–67; coded-choice and attachment keyword notes and ArcGIS Server feature-layer download exception, lines 68–73.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official results/export page and inspected available formats, coded values, attachment notes, and the ArcGIS Server exception.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: CSV/Excel and GIS formats are available through the website, but surveys created from ArcGIS Server feature layers cannot be downloaded there. CSV/Excel store choice names, and file-geodatabase export removes the attachment KEYWORD field.
sources.applicability: Supports Survey123 export comparison and identifies an Enterprise deployment caveat omitted from the investigator's comparison.

sources.title: Collecting data using KoboCollect — KoboToolbox documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living support documentation; page says last updated 2026-07-17; app/server build not pinned.
sources.locator: Android/offline use and initial form-download prerequisites, lines 7–40; offline collection and finalized upload, lines 49–57 and 79–91.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official Kobo support page and inspected offline collection, online form-download/update requirements, and bulk upload.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A deployed form must be downloaded with internet first; after download, collection can be offline. Form-update retrieval needs connectivity; finalized submissions may be uploaded later/in bulk.
sources.applicability: Supports Kobo as a screened Android option and explains a form-version risk for volunteers returning late.

sources.title: Editing and deleting your data — KoboToolbox documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living support documentation; page says last updated 2026-05-06; app/server build not pinned.
sources.locator: Post-submit edit path and UUID changes, lines 10–43; external log and non-undoable raw edits, lines 44–61; `_uuid` / `rootUuid`, lines 121–131.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official correction page and inspected edit locations, UUID lineage, latest-form behavior, and edit-log advice.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Post-submit changes are made in KoboToolbox. Saved edits change `_uuid` while `rootUuid` stays stable; web-form edits use the latest form and can alter logic-dependent values. Raw edits cannot be undone and should be tracked externally.
sources.applicability: Supports screening Kobo's correction-history caveat; does not establish legacy CSV row import.

sources.title: 2.1. Introduction to Replication — Apache CouchDB documentation
sources.locator: Replication checkpoint behavior, section 2.1, page line 24.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the version-pinned primary replication documentation and checked the checkpoint passage.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Replication tasks create destination checkpoint documents so a restarted task can continue from where it stopped, including after a crash.
sources.applicability: Supports restartable transport as a conceptual analogy; CouchDB is not a survey product recommendation.

sources.title: 2.3. Replication and conflict model — Apache CouchDB documentation
sources.locator: Revision branches and conflict leaves, lines 82–101; winner visibility and explicit application resolution, lines 104–135 and 197–226.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the version-pinned conflict documentation and read revision tree, winner, conflict retrieval, and resolution passages.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Conflicting leaves can coexist; a normal read exposes only the deterministic winner unless conflicts are requested. An application can inspect all leaves and choose display/merge/resolution.
sources.applicability: Supports the analogy while warning against inheriting database winner selection as the charity's owner decision.

sources.title: Formulas — ArcGIS Survey123 documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation retrieved 2026-10-10; formula feature conditions are stated on the page; app build not pinned.
sources.locator: `pulldata()` CSV lookup and its app availability, lines 454–468; function summary, lines 191–200.
sources.observed_operation: Searched and opened the official Survey123 formula documentation to check whether CSV support means legacy response import.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: `pulldata()` can preload a value from a local/linked CSV into a form in Survey123 Connect/field app; the docs do not describe importing legacy rows as existing survey submissions.
sources.applicability: Evidence for the narrow distinction in C-02; it is not evidence that Survey123 has no import path through other ArcGIS services or adapters.
